article.story: COLUMBIA, S.C. -- — Marcus Johnson had 20 points, six assists and five steals as South Carolina cruised by Saint Peter's 77-41 on Tuesday night. The Gamecocks are 3-0 for the second consecutive season and third time in head coach Lamont Paris' five years. South Carolina shot 47% overall, including 60% from beyond the arc, and made 26 of 34 attempts from the free-throw line. Aleksas Bieliauskas scored 11 points, nine of them in the first half, and Davion Hannah had 10 along with six rebounds. The Gamecocks had multiple 9-0 runs in the first half and held the Peacocks to just 17 points on the way to a 20-point halftime lead. They opened the second on an 11-0 run, and added two more 9-0 runs on their way to a rout. Xavier Thomas scored 15 for the Peacocks (0-4) and Bryce Eaton had 10. Saint Peter's struggled shooting, with 26% and 18% marks from the field and from deep, respectively. South Carolina's win evened the series at one game each. The two programs last met on January 16th, 1990, a 57-56 Peacocks win in Jersey City. Up next Saint Peter's: at UMas Lowell on Tuesday. South Carolina: vs. Gardner-Webb on Saturday for their fourth straight home game. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
